sloka: यस्य प्रसादे सततम् प्रसीदेयुः इमाः प्रजाः ।स रामः वानरेन्द्रस्य प्रसादम् अभिकाङ्क्षते ॥४-४-२१॥
transliteration: yasya prasāde satatam prasīdeyuḥ imāḥ prajāḥ ।sa rāmaḥ vānarendrasya prasādam abhikāṅkṣate ॥4-4-21॥

translations.english: 'This Rama for whose grace the subjects were ever bobolden to him now seeks the favour of the Chief of monkeys.
